_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Toggle each source on/off. The location filter is the safety net that keeps out-of-area listings out of your results.
_fb_help: search_urls = Facebook Marketplace result pages. IMPORTANT: build them in your browser with Location set to Vancouver and a radius (e.g. 20 km) and category = Property Rentals, then paste the URL. Avoid bare ?query= searches — they ignore location. Leave empty [] to skip Facebook.
_location_help: Safety net applied to every source (checked against the listing text AND its URL slug). A listing is kept only if it mentions one of location_allow and none of location_block. This list is tuned to Vancouver PROPER — to include the suburbs, add e.g. 'burnaby','richmond','north vancouver' to location_allow and remove them from location_block. Set location_allow to [] to disable.
_craigslist_help: Two filters keep CL local: (1) only listings on {site}.craigslist.org are kept (drops 'nearby areas' links to other cities' subdomains); (2) subareas restricts to the parts of that site you want. The vancouver site splits the Lower Mainland into subareas in the URL path — van=city of Vancouver, bnc=Burnaby/NewWest, nvn=north shore, rds=richmond/delta, pml=tri-cities. Read the code off any listing URL (vancouver.craigslist.org/<code>/apa/...). subareas=['van'] = Vancouver proper; [] = all. search_distance(miles)+postal or your own pasted search_urls are alternative ways to bound the radius.
_sites_help: Generic browser sources. link_pattern is a regex matched against each <a href> on the search page to find listing links. Rentals.ca works well; PadMapper/Zumper are map-based SPAs with anti-bot, so they're best-effort — start with enabled=false and turn on once you've checked the output.
